title: Our multi-agent design: five roles
points: The roles pass structured results to each other. Llama handles planning and refinement; Python runs the other stages.
note: This is a custom, role-based Python workflow. It is not five independent LLMs. One Llama 3.1:8b model is called with the Planning Agent and LLM Optimizer roles. Awareness, simulation and verification run Python. The default notebook displays saved role traces in L10 and saved selected episodes in L10B; it does not execute a new multi-agent LLM run. The handoff is structured case facts, candidate IDs, tool results and checks, not an invented agent conversation. src/proposal_workflow.py defines CORE_STAGES, run_proposal_case, evaluate and the ranking guard. A final independent recheck precedes MODEL_RECOMMEND. Human acknowledgment remains separate and pending. Hash checks detect changed records but do not authenticate telemetry.
caption: Custom Python workflow, one Llama model in two roles. L10 displays its saved trace.
source_label: Five-role implementation: src/proposal_workflow.py; recorded results: proposal_complete_workflow.json.

The L10 lindistflow3 restoration record uses a feeder bypass catalog. SHED_075 returns 1843.61355 kW served and 474.03975 critical kW at 91.86721465 percent allowed-current use. title: Five roles in the cyber case
points: The workflow keeps the trust assumption visible. It cannot create trusted data from a convincing answer.
note: This is a custom, role-based Python workflow. It is not five independent LLMs. One Llama 3.1:8b model is called with the Planning Agent and LLM Optimizer roles. Awareness, simulation and verification run Python. The default notebook displays saved role traces in L10 and saved selected episodes in L10B; it does not execute a new multi-agent LLM run. The handoff is structured case facts, candidate IDs, tool results and checks, not an invented agent conversation. src/proposal_workflow.py defines CORE_STAGES, run_proposal_case, evaluate and the ranking guard. A final independent recheck precedes MODEL_RECOMMEND. Human acknowledgment remains separate and pending. Hash checks detect changed records but do not authenticate telemetry. Awareness preserves the declared measurement-trust condition. Planning requests the initial candidates; Python runs the estimator and constrained-response tools. The optimizer requests EXTRA_MARGIN_001 and TRUSTED_QP. The selected final recheck uses TRUSTED_QP with u=0.1216936673 per unit and predicted flow12=0.17 per unit against a 0.18 limit. The model checks a four-bus DC fixture with three protected angles assumed trustworthy. No stage authenticates those channels, and offline truth is not fed to Llama.
caption: L10 four-bus DC cyber_stealth archive. Trusted channels are assumed.

title: What the evidence shows
points: In L10, five paired final costs tied; one Llama route was worse.
Start with past cases and read-only use. Measure benefit against the same tools in a fixed script.
note: The six matched fixed-versus-Llama runs in proposal_complete_workflow.json have five tied final costs and one worse Llama voltage result. Recorded model calls add elapsed time. This demonstrates traceable coordination, not better power-flow solvers or general efficiency. Test any proposed benefit against the same tools and budgets. A control-room pilot starts with archived cases, then read-only shadow studies and a limited reviewed scope.
